attributes.residual: ONE INSTRUCTION, mechanism named and measured. Instruction count is now EXACT (target 32 / ours 32) and every other row matches: `addi r31,r1,0`, `stmw r30,40(r1)`, the `addi r3,r31,16` / `bl __unexpected` / `b .` island, and the `mr r12,r31` / `lwz r0,52(r31)` / `lmw r30,40(r12)` / `lwz r1,0(r1)` teardown all reproduce. The sole difference is the POSITION of `mr r3,r30`: the target emits it inside the epilogue between `lwz r0,52(r31)` and `lmw r30,40(r12)`; our build emits it at the end of the guarded body, before the branch to the epilogue, where it also serves as the convergence label. Per claim.law.destructor-implicit-return-this-places-the-return-move-in-the-epilogue.20260831.v1 (recorded this session from a decisive two-form scratch compile) that placement is produced ONLY by a genuine C++ destructor's compiler-synthesised `return this`, never by an explicit `return self;`. NEXT STEP for a follow-up lane: establish the class identity from the vtable at lbl_801296A4 and its construction sites, then convert both dtors together and rename the two symbols with gdlmem.py rename-symbol. DO NOT re-probe statement reordering or temp-variable returns: a temp-variable form was measured and is strictly worse (adds a stack slot, frame 48 -> 56).
